entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extension member and extension implementation are not tracked together by IDE #81507
  • Test plan for "extension indexers" feature #81505
  • Searching for Code Style rule names/values/options don't appear in Search Results in Options Pane or Dialog #81502
  • Roslyn fails to infer correct nullability with 'default' values and/or unused parameters #81501
  • CS0103 Triggers for nameof-expression inside extension property #81496

Closed

  • Unexpected nullable warning passing null to an oblivious parameter #40751
    Backlog
  • The new C# extension block syntax incorrectly triggers CA1515 #81483
  • Completion should include C# 14 extension property in object initializers #81405
    18.3
  • Intellisense missing extension property - in initializer #81497
  • IDE0048 triggers for `is null` but not for `is not null` in null-coalescing expressions #81488
  • Visual Studio - Error List: `Build + IntelliSense` does not contain an error shown in `Build` #19693
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11301.14 #81494
  • Visual Studio2026 the tooltip is missing on hover #81357
  • question for the roslyn development team #81491
  • .NET10/C#14 - NRE within GetDiagnostics when extension property has no outer class #81476
  • .NET 10 based source generator and false IDE unresolved symbol errors #81475

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix comment to clarify managed type definition #81509
    Area-Compilers
  • Update Roslyn LSP server to .net10 #81508
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add Extension Indexers feature to Language Status #81506
    Area-Compilers
  • Merge latest bits from `main` into `features/extensions` #81504
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Enable IDE0370 #81500
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix missing diagnostic about omitted type args on dynamic member access. #81495
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Remove unnecessary suppressions #81499
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Report basic text changes if span mapping isn't available #81492
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update Roslyn LSP server to .net10 #81308
  • Include extension properties in object initializer completion #81498
    VSCode, Next
  • Fix IDE0048 to trigger consistently for `is null` and `is not null` in coalesce expressions #81489
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Suppress CS0119 when CS0075 is reported for negative cast #81283
    Area-Compilers
  • Track runtime-async-streams feature as part of runtime-async work #81447
    Area-Compilers
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Assert shape of the bound tree #81486
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix incorrect code generation on async iterators #81468
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Async Streams
  • Fix RoslynAssembliesPath when toolset package is used in fx builds #81344
    Area-Compilers
  • EnC: Block additions to MethodImpl table when targeting .NET Framework #81304
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Use single argument overload for `[start..]` of `string` or `Span` #81485
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Unsafe evolution: handle the rest of pointer-related operations #81420
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Mark ERR_FunctionPointerTypesInAttributeNotSupported as build-only #81453
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Adjust behavior of is-type operator for `Union` types #81448
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • Do not copy hoisted locals or parameters unnecessarily #81227
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Fix null refs of freshly constructed syntax trivia #81444
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81478
    Area-Infrastructure
